findings.title: deposit mints zero shares without a check, so a donation-inflated pool takes depositors' tokens
Claim-to-LP conversion uses min_amount_out = 0, so the claimed BLND can be converted at a manipulated Comet price
initialize() has no caller authorization, so the first caller can set the pool factory, emitter and tokens
LP token valuation is a permissionless spot read of Comet balances that a direct transfer can inflate
gulp_emissions advances the distribution clock with an empty reward zone, dropping that period's emissions
Duplicate pool addresses in claim() overwrite the per-pool claim amounts, so the claimant's BLND is converted to LP tokens that are never credited
Division by zero when every pool share is queued for withdrawal, which blocks emission updates and gulp_emissions for all pools
update_tkn_val is permissionless and caches a Comet valuation read from raw token balances that anyone can move
draw() removes tokens without excluding amounts queued for withdrawal
First-time user balance and emissions entries are written to persistent storage without extend_ttl
Soroban contract arithmetic can wrap around in release builds
Unpinned dependencies
initialize() swaps the BLND and USDC token addresses relative to the public trait
update_tkn_val panics when the Comet LP has zero total supply because the divisor is not guarded
Deposits into a pool whose backstop tokens were fully drawn panic with division by zero
Reward-zone swap compares total tokens, but emissions are weighted by non-queued tokens
load_pool_backstop_data divides by zero for pools with no shares, breaking the public pool_data view
convert_to_shares divides by zero when a pool has shares but no tokens, blocking deposits and claims
Zero-amount queue_withdrawal succeeds with no shares and grows the Q4W list without limit
gulp_emissions panics when every reward-zone pool has zero non-queued tokens

failing_checks.title: Per-action amount bound
failing_checks.reason: Balance-based bounds exist (pool.rs line 153 rejects tokens above pool tokens and shares above q4w), but draw() caps the amount at total tokens and not at non-queued tokens, so queued-for-withdrawal backstop tokens can be drawn. This is the already-recorded control bypass.

failing_checks.title: Recipient binding
failing_checks.reason: Claim authenticates only from. The shares minted to `to` (claim.rs line 64, add_shares) are credited to an arbitrary address whose owner never authorized the claim, and the recipient is not bound to the caller. This is the already-recorded issue.

failing_checks.title: Asset identity and units
failing_checks.reason: Assets are identified by contract id, which is correct, and amounts are i128 stroops with no float parsing. But initialize() declares usdc_token before blnd_token (line 182-183), which contradicts the trait order (blnd first). The contract then stores the two token ids swapped relative to the public

failing_checks.title: Slippage and quoted prices
failing_checks.reason: The BLND-to-LP conversion uses min_amount_out = 0 (claim.rs line 50 `&0,`), so no minimum is enforced. The claimed BLND amount is fixed by emissions, not by the requester, but the price is determined by Comet's current pool state, so it can be sandwiched. This is the already-recorded issue.
